svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut six inlet legs 1175 mm long (two per 10 ft pipe) and six

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: outlet legs 866 mm (three per pipe). Thread one end of each.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Degrease, coat every thread with nickel anti-seize, then join:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: outlet leg, elbow, 4 in nipple, elbow, inlet leg, wrench tight.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Turn the second elbow so both legs stand parallel, in one plane.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Leg centres 155 mm apart (the fittings make 155.6 mm).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The elbows rest on the drum floor; the run is 28 mm above it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the short leg (outlet) stands on the 80 mm circle and ends inside

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the collector; the long leg (inlet) on the 235 mm circle, ending

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: inside the inlet plenum, 130 mm above the jacket cap.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: legs parallel within 3 mm over their length; blow through
